pins.title: Gift for Tired Parents: Why a Sauna Blanket Can Beat a Spa Gift Card
pins.subtitle: No booking, no childcare, no leaving home
pins.description: A spa gift card means booking, arranging childcare, and leaving the house, so it can sit unused for months. A sauna blanket lives at home and can be used after the kids are asleep, which may make it an easier gift to enjoy. Skip it for anyone pregnant, and anyone with high blood pressure or a heart condition should talk to a doctor first. Not medical advice. #giftsforparents #saunablanket #giftguide #selfcareathome #recoverygifts

pins.title: Oura Ring Gift for Her: 3 Things to Check Before You Buy
pins.subtitle: Ring size, data stress, Apple Watch
pins.description: Thinking about an Oura Ring gift? Check three things first: can you get her ring size, does she enjoy sleep data or stress over it, and is she already loyal to an Apple Watch? Oura sells a sizing kit separately, and for some people close sleep tracking can add anxiety. Not a wearable person? A weighted blanket is a lower-pressure option. Not medical advice. #ouraring #smartring #giftsforher #sleeptracker #giftguide

pins.title: Massage Gun Gift for a Desk Worker: Why a Compact Model Often Fits Better
pins.subtitle: Simpler and less intense than full-size
pins.description: Shopping for someone who sits at a desk all day, not a serious athlete? Compact massage guns tend to be the better gift for non-athletes: simpler and less intense than full-size devices, and small enough for a desk drawer. Compare the Theragun Mini and Hypervolt Go 2, plus when to skip this gift, like an injury you don't fully understand. Not medical advice. #massagegun #giftsforhim #deskworker #theragun #recoverygifts #giftguide
